**About Tarro**
Our vision
  
  
Tarro is building the future of restaurant infrastructure. The U.S. restaurant industry is a trillion-dollar market, but it remains relatively underserved by technology. Running a restaurant comes with a never-ending list of operational work, and many owners spend most of their day on what they have to do rather than what they want to do. We envision a future where they can delegate that work to Tarro and focus on what they love doing.
  
  
Restaurant owners want more orders, better margins, and fewer operational headaches. Giving them software is only part of the answer. Our ecosystem brings phone ordering, online ordering, delivery, point of sale, payments, and marketing into one vertically integrated operation. We combine software, AI, and human operations so independent restaurants can hand that work to us end to end.
  
  
Using Tarro should feel like having experienced operators, engineers, and marketers working for your restaurant. Our job is to turn that expertise into services owners can rely on, without having to build those teams themselves.
  
  
Our traction
  
  
Thousands of restaurants have entrusted Tarro with their success. Since 2020, we’ve processed close to $3 billion in restaurant orders, helped those restaurants serve more than 20 million consumers, and taken an estimated 3 million hours of work off their teams’ hands. And we’re still early in our journey.
  
  
Our team
  
  
We’re a lean team with top talent from OpenAI, Meta, Google, Tesla, Square, Stripe, Shopify, and Citadel. We’re scrappy builders who love to roll up our sleeves and get into the details of improving a restaurant’s operations. Many of us regularly work in restaurants to experience firsthand what our users deal with.
  
  
We move quickly, keep process light, and expect high standards of craft. Our leaders stay hands-on, and our teams have the autonomy to make decisions and the responsibility to see them through.
  
  
At Tarro, product judgment and technical execution belong together. You’ll be trusted to understand the restaurant’s problem, decide how to solve it, and carry the solution through to something people use every day. If you want to build products restaurant owners depend on, we’d love to work with you.
  
  
**What We're Looking For**
We are looking to hire a Data Scientist to drive impactful insights and build data-driven solutions across multiple Tarro product areas. In this role, you’ll analyze complex datasets, develop predictive models, and collaborate closely with product, engineering, operations and a variety of stakeholders. You’ll own end-to-end data initiatives, deploy models into production, and play a critical role in shaping Tarro’s growth and evolution. As a key member of our growing team, you’ll move fast, experiment often, and wear many hats to uncover patterns, optimize decision-making, and solve high-impact business challenges.
  
  
**What You Will Accomplish**

* You will be responsible for owning entire data science model pipelines, from development to support
* You will help make key decisions on the technologies and tools we use as we scale
* You will write high quality code for all parts of our data science pipelines.
* You will work closely with Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, Product and other functions to define and execute on data diagnosis, prediction, prescriptive and experimentation requirements
* You will create scalable data science models following software and data engineering practices like versioning, CI/CD, workflow orchestration, data ops and ml ops
* You will implement rigorous code reviews and testing guidelines to ensure that we have a high quality data science products
* You will create and improve our data science CI/CD pipeline to enable high developer velocity
* You will help in improving the life of independent restaurant owners and ultimately their customers

**About You**

* You have Bachelors in Computer Science or Engineering, Statistics, or equivalent experience.
* You have 3+ years of ELT/ETL, data exploration, transformation and building production models.
* You have 3+ years working with cloud databases, such as Snowflake, Redshift or similar
* Practical experience with statistical testing (p/t/z tests, power analysis), time series, regression/classification, clustering, and NLP.
* You have experience with programming languages such as Python and its usage for data processing, making API calls along with Advanced SQL
* You have built with at least one of OpenAI/Anthropic/Google/OSS (Llama/Mistral), using embeddings, RAG (vector DB + hybrid search + re-ranking), prompt engineering, function/tool calling, JSON-schema outputs, and evaluation frameworks (e.g., prompt/unit tests, hallucination checks).
* You have exposure to MLflow or equivalent for experiment tracking/model registry; data & model versioning; orchestration (Dagster/Airflow); containerization (Docker) and monitoring (latency, cost, quality)
* You have exceptional product sense, communication and bias to ship

**Bonus Points**

* You have experience with dbt, Dagster, MLflow/DVC, Weights & Biases, or Feast/feature stores.
* You are obsessed with data and patterns to solve business problems.
* You will be jumping in deep into a new territory for the business, and you have a strong hunger to learn along with us.
* You got Restaurant tech or marketplace/logistics experience; you’re customer-obsessed and love turning noisy operational data into outcomes.

MongoDB’s Application Modernization Platform (AMP) helps organizations modernize legacy applications and move their workloads and associated data from relational databases to MongoDB. Our customers need a dependable way to bring analysis, transformation, testing, and migration capabilities into their modernization workflows.
The Agentic Integrations team builds the interfaces that let AMP capabilities be discovered, invoked, and orchestrated from AI agents and development environments. We expose product services through consistent, well-specified tool and API surfaces, keep authentication and execution context correct across every boundary, and make each integration observable and safe to operate. Our work is what makes AMP usable from the assistants and coding agents our customers already run.
We are looking for a Software Engineer 3 to build and operate these integrations. You will design tool and API surfaces for AMP services, implement them end to end, and work with product and platform engineers so that they behave predictably when a model calls them. Your impact will be measured by how reliably agents and developers can invoke AMP capabilities, and by how much integration work your components remove for other teams.
We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in New York City for our hybrid working model.
What you will do
Design and implement agent and developer facing integrations for AMP services, including tool definitions, API clients, and the adapters between them
Define clear input and output contracts for each integration, including validation, error semantics, and behavior when a call is malformed or only partially succeeds
Propagate authentication, authorization, and tenant context across integration boundaries so that agent-invoked calls carry no more privilege than the user they act for
Build the instrumentation needed to observe agent-driven traffic, including structured logs, traces, latency and failure metrics, and actionable diagnostics
Write production-quality code and the unit, integration, and end-to-end tests that demonstrate correctness, including tests for nondeterministic model behavior
Diagnose failures that span service, tool, and model boundaries, and drive them to root cause
Contribute integrations to shared SDKs, command-line tools, and agent frameworks used by other teams
Collaborate with product managers, platform engineers, and partner teams on scoped initiatives, and break work into incremental deliverables
Participate in code reviews, design reviews, and technical discussions that raise the quality of the team’s work
Interview candidates and mentor engineers and interns
What you bring
Required
At least four years of experience building and operating production software services
Proficiency in a backend language such as Python, Go, Java, or TypeScript, with the judgment to work effectively in more than one
Experience designing APIs or service interfaces, including versioning, error handling, and backward compatibility
Practical experience with authentication and authorization mechanisms such as OAuth, API keys, or service-to-service identity
Experience with automated testing, continuous delivery, and debugging in distributed systems
Strong written and verbal technical communication skills
A collaborative approach and the ability to make realistic assessments of project complexity and delivery risk
Preferred
Experience building tool or integration surfaces for AI agents or large language models, including execution context, tool schemas, or guardrails against nondeterministic behavior
Experience with the Model Context Protocol or a comparable agent-to-tool integration standard
Experience shipping developer tooling such as CLIs, SDKs, or local servers that run inside customer-managed environments
Familiarity with application modernization, relational databases, MongoDB, or automated code transformation
Experience working with customers or field teams on integration and deployment issues
Experience mentoring engineers or interns and contributing to technical hiring
Candidates with additional relevant experience may be considered for more senior roles.
What success looks like
In your first month
Build a working understanding of AMP’s architecture, the team’s integration patterns, and the development and testing workflow.
Ship small, well-scoped integration fixes and contribute effectively to code reviews.
In your first three months
Own delivery of an integration for one AMP capability, from interface definition through production rollout.
Establish the tests and telemetry that let the team detect and diagnose failures in that integration.
In your first six months
Take regular ownership of code reviews and participate meaningfully in design reviews for agent-facing interfaces.
Independently drive a scoped technical project from investigation through implementation and validation, coordinating with the partner team that consumes it.
In your first twelve months
Lead the development of a substantial integration or reusable component that other teams adopt.
Help mentor new engineers and contribute to the team’s integration standards and technical direction.
Why MongoDB
At MongoDB, you will work with engineers who care deeply about developer experience, data correctness, and the interfaces that other software builds on. The Agentic Integrations team sits where the data platform meets the agentic tooling our customers are adopting, so your work will be visible in the products and assistants they use every day. You will have the scope to shape how AMP capabilities are exposed, and the support to grow into deeper ownership of the integration layer.

Mentor fellow engineers and assume ownership and accountability of projects

Strong background in building core components for high scale compute and data distributed systems
